objects.definition:
enum class OperatorId {
  kConditional = 1,
  kLogicalAnd,
  kLogicalOr,
  kLogicalNot,
  kEquals,
  kNotEquals,
  kLess,
  kLessEquals,
  kGreater,
  kGreaterEquals,
  kAdd,
  kSubtract,
  kMultiply,
  kDivide,
  kModulo,
  kNegate,
  kIndex,
  kIn,
  kNotStrictlyFalse,
  kOldIn,
  kOldNotStrictlyFalse,
};
objects.description: Strongly-typed enumerator of all CEL operator identifiers supported by this API, used as the canonical id across Operator and its arity-specific wrappers.
Enumeration of operator arity values used to categorize operators as unary, binary, or ternary.
Subset enum aliasing OperatorId values corresponding to unary operators for type-safe APIs that only accept unary operators.

objects.definition:
enum class BinaryOperatorId {
  kLogicalAnd = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kLogicalAnd),
  kLogicalOr = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kLogicalOr),
  kEquals = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kEquals),
  kNotEquals = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kNotEquals),
  kLess = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kLess),
  kLessEquals = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kLessEquals),
  kGreater = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kGreater),
  kGreaterEquals = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kGreaterEquals),
  kAdd = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kAdd),
  kSubtract = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kSubtract),
  kMultiply = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kMultiply),
  kDivide = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kDivide),
  kModulo = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kModulo),
  kIndex = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kIndex),
  kIn = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kIn),
  kOldIn = static_cast<int>(OperatorId::kOldIn),
};
objects.description: Subset enum aliasing OperatorId values corresponding to binary operators for type-safe APIs that only accept binary operators.
Subset enum aliasing OperatorId values corresponding to ternary operators for type-safe APIs that only accept ternary operators.

Value-type handle for any CEL operator. It wraps a pointer to immutable OperatorData describing id, names, precedence, and arity. Instances are obtained via static factory methods or by converting from arity-specific wrappers. No dynamic allocation ownership; compares and hashes by id.

Arity-specific wrapper for unary operators. Provides type-safe id, accessors, and conversion to general Operator. Constructed via static methods or from Operator that has unary arity; otherwise construction may assert/crash.

Arity-specific wrapper for binary operators. Provides type-safe id, accessors, and conversion to general Operator. Constructed via static methods or from Operator that has binary arity; otherwise construction may assert/crash.

Arity-specific wrapper for ternary operators. Provides type-safe id, accessors, and conversion to general Operator. Constructed via static method or from Operator that has ternary arity; otherwise construction may assert/crash.

POD-like immutable descriptor for an operator used internally by Operator and its wrappers. Stores id, managed and display names, precedence, and arity. Not default-constructible or movable/copyable to enforce static storage usage.

functions.name: cel::Operator::Index

functions.name: cel::Operator::OldNotStrictlyFalse

functions.name: cel::Operator::FindByName
functions.description: Looks up an operator by its managed name (e.g., "_&&_", "_?_:_", "_[_]"). Returns nullopt if not found.
requirements: Input is treated as a name token; matching behavior beyond exact comparison is unknown
Passing any absl::string_view (including empty) is allowed; empty will not match any operator

functions.name: cel::Operator::FindByDisplayName
functions.description: Looks up an operator by its source text (display) name (e.g., "&&", "||", "in"). Some operators (like Conditional and Index) have an empty display name and cannot be found by display name.
requirements: Input may be any absl::string_view; empty will not match operators without an empty display name (most)
Returns nullopt when there is no match

functions.name: cel::Operator::id
functions.description: Returns this operator’s unique id.
requirements: The Operator instance must be valid (constructed via provided factory functions); object has no default constructor

functions.name: cel::Operator::name
functions.description: Returns the managed (internal) operator name, such as "_&&_". May be empty for certain operators.

functions.name: cel::Operator::display_name
functions.description: Returns the source text representation (e.g., "&&"). May be empty for operators like Conditional and Index.

functions.name: cel::Operator::precedence
functions.description: Returns the operator precedence value (higher means binds less tightly per header comment ordering).

functions.name: cel::Operator::arity
functions.description: Returns the operator arity as an enum (kUnary, kBinary, kTernary).
